resources.string: Sign-in did not return an authorization code.
Sign-in did not match this app (another tab may have opened, or the screen was left open too long). Close other Spotify browser tabs and tap Connect again.
Sign-in data was lost before returning to the app. Try Connect again and complete login in the same tab.
Could not save sign-in data. Please try again.
Starting a new sign-in. Close any other approval tabs in your browser, then approve only in the tab that opens next.
Approve Spotify in the browser tab that just opened. If you tapped Connect more than once, close older Spotify tabs and approve only in the newest one.
Sign in to TIDAL in the window that just opened. If you tapped Connect more than once, close older TIDAL or Playmix tabs and complete only the newest one.
Opening your default browser — allow JavaScript; pause ad blockers for TIDAL if login fails.
TIDAL dashboard: add Android redirect URI exactly: com.playmix.app://oauth/tidal (in addition to any web URL). Emulators are often blocked; try a phone and Chrome from the chooser.
No app can open this link. Install a browser, then try Connect again.
Server did not return a refresh token. Try revoking app access and signing in again.
Can\'t connect - this service isn\'t configured in this build.
Play the playlist or tap a track. Audio goes to your active Spotify device (phone, computer, or Web Player).
This device isn\'t running the Spotify app. Playback is controlled via Spotify Connect on your active device.
Spotify Client ID is not configured.
Repeat: off, playlist, or one track
